title: A HEART THAT MOVES YOU TO COME

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work." - Exod 36:2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Two things had to meet: ability given by God, and a heart willing to come.

Both were necessary. Skilled people who stayed home built nothing. Willing people is what turned gift into service.

That combination still matters. Every church has capable people sitting quietly, and every church has eager people who need training. God's work goes forward when ability and willingness meet in the same person.

It is worth asking honestly which side we are on. Some of us hold back because we underestimate what God has given us. Others of us are busy but have never developed the ability to do the thing well. Both need addressing.

Notice also that Moses summoned them. Someone called. Gifts often lie dormant until a person says, "I think God has given you something — would you use it?" Barnabas did this for Saul, going to look for him and bringing him into the work at Antioch (Acts 11:25-26).

Maybe today you are the one being summoned. Or maybe you are the one who should be doing the summoning — noticing a quiet, capable person and inviting them in.

Willingness is the part God leaves to us.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you holding back ability God has given you?
2. Who around you has a gift that needs to be called out?
3. What would it take for you to say yes to something this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I am willing. Show me where to serve, and give me courage to begin. Amen.
